steps.text: Hey
Quick update regarding {{name:hailey}}
How did it go?
Honestly, better than expected
She has some gaps to work on, but nothing alarming
Most of the issue seems to be organization rather than ability
This was from earlier while we were reviewing her notes
She stayed focused for most of the session
That's surprising
She'll be happy to hear that reaction 😄
Jokes aside, I think she can catch up if she stays consistent
That's reassuring
Fortunately, I don't have another student taking this time slot right now
So if you'd like, I can keep working with her all the way to the exam
I think she'd benefit from that
Please keep me updated on her progress
Don't hesitate to send pictures
I will make an album of her working, she'll love it
Haha, I'll try to send some then
I'll keep you updated on her progress
Thanks, I appreciate it
